name: Star Scrier
body:
You have received enhanced gifts by the heavens.

Prerequisite(s): Heavens mystery, mystery magic class feature.

Benefit(s): You add your stargazer level and your cleric level to your oracle level when determining the effects of all revelations from the Heavens mystery.

Legendary Prestige, © 2023, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
